title: SwitchControl 1.0.5 — Power Plan Cleanup + Trial Security Update
headline: Trial expiry is now airtight. All SwitchControl power plans are deleted on revert, duplicates are cleaned up automatically, and the system is verified clean before the modal closes.
changes: Fixed trial expiry leaving duplicate SwitchControl plans in Windows Power Options
Fixed power plan revert not deleting app-created plans — all SC plans are now removed on expiry
Fixed app creating a new power plan every session instead of reusing the existing one
Added automatic cleanup of orphaned SwitchControl plans on every startup for free users
Added post-revert verification — confirms active plan is Windows Balanced and no SC plans remain
Revert modal now shows the confirmed active plan name and a verified clean indicator
Improved SC plan detection: uses ownership records and plan name prefix as dual fallback
User-created custom power plans are never touched — only app-owned SC plans are removed
Fixed startup sanity check missing SC plans when the internal plan registry was reset
Improved overall trial expiry reliability across reinstall and plan-switch edge cases
